import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")


# Text cleaning function
def clean_comments(comments):
    return [
        " ".join(c.strip('"').lower().split()) if isinstance(c, str) else ""
        for c in comments
    ]


train_clean = clean_comments(train_df["Comment"])
test_clean = clean_comments(test_df["Comment"])

# Feature extraction with TF-IDF
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=40000, sublinear_tf=True
)
vectorizer.fit(train_clean)

X_train = vectorizer.transform(train_clean)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_clean)

# Stratified train/validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# XGBoost Classifier
pos_weight = np.sum(y_train == 0) / max(np.sum(y_train == 1), 1)
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    eval_metric="auc",
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    scale_pos_weight=pos_weight,
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validation AUC-ROC
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")

# Generate test predictions
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame({"Insult": test_probs}).to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
